docs.text: Metformin is the first-line treatment for type 2 diabetes. Long-term metformin use may cause vitamin B12 deficiency. Aspirin reduces the risk of myocardial infarction in patients with cardiovascular disease, but it can cause gastric bleeding. The study also recorded smoking status and the incidence of lung cancer. Chronic alcohol consumption causes liver cirrhosis. Statins were prescribed to lower cholesterol and prevent stroke.
